result.summary: This is a high-volume, multi-lane intersection currently undergoing significant construction, which has completely obstructed any potential pedestrian pathways on the right side. There are no visible marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or dedicated pedestrian infrastructure, making it a highly hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Construction Obstruction
hazards.description: Orange plastic barriers and barrels completely block the area where a sidewalk or pedestrian path would normally be located.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals despite its large size and multiple lanes.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Access Route
interventions.description: Provide a clear, signed, and protected path for pedestrians through or around the construction zone.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install countdown pedestrian signals to provide clear timing for crossing the wide roadway.

result.summary: The intersection is currently a construction zone with newly installed sidewalks and curb ramps, but it lacks essential pedestrian safety features like marked crosswalks and signals. Large temporary signs and barriers obstruct sightlines and create a disjointed environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Construction Zone
hazards.description: Unfinished pavement and temporary barriers create a hazardous and confusing environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane intersection with a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and traffic signal control. While a sidewalk and curb ramp are present on the left, the lack of a pedestrian refuge island and the significant crossing distance across four or more lanes of traffic create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Construction Obstruction
hazards.description: Orange construction barrels are placed near the sidewalk and curb ramp, potentially narrowing the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
